name.description: An explicit null clears the override; the field is required.

AuthenticationFailure.description: Last native authentication failure, retained in RAM for development diagnostics.

ConnectionSecurity.description:
Observed properties of the current Bluetooth link, never requested policy.
None means the backend cannot report that property. Key size is in bytes.

effective_enabled.description: Runtime admission; `enabled_reason` explains why it is false.

enabled.description: Persisted Bluetooth enablement preference, independent of `hidpp_enabled`.

transport_supported.description: Derived from the current backend's transports; never persisted.

DeviceInfo.description: Full snapshot for responses; only changed fields for device.info.changed.

DeviceKind.description:
Discovery hint from advertised BLE Appearance or Classic Class of Device.
Unknown includes devices whose advertised metadata does not identify an input type.

DisabledReason.description: Why a saved device is not effectively enabled, in precedence order.

EnabledCapacity.description:
One native constraint on ordinarily enabled bonds. `limit` excludes the
entry reserved for temporary pairing.

ErrorCode.description: Machine codes only. Human explanations belong to the host application.

supported.description: The firmware has a usable handler; not a device-provided flag.

FeatureId.description: Stable protocol feature number, independent of each device's feature table.

FeatureIndex.description: Index assigned by the connected peripheral, not a feature number.

GattWriteDiagnostic.description: Development-only recent GATT writes for up to four tokens; no report payloads.

value.description: At most 64 UTF-8 bytes; no control characters.

PairUnavailable.description: Why status reports Pair unavailable for a transport.

PairingCapacity.description:
Advisory per-transport pairing admission. Estimates share resources and
must not be added together.

ProtocolResult.description: The discovery result accepts additional fields from future firmware.

ProtocolState.description: Protocol negotiation on the current connection, independent of feature readiness.

SettingKey.description: Explicit codes: persisted setting-record keys use them, so never renumber.

StorageOutcome.description: `details.outcome` of a `storage_failed` error; absent means not saved.

ValidationError.description: Structured stored-record validation problem for a saved device.
